description: Builds a daily health digest (steps, sleep, recovery, HRV, training-load model) for one date and appends it as markdown to a history file. Keeps running CTL/ATL and per-metric averages in a sidecar file (SUUNTO_DIGEST_AVERAGES_PATH, default ~/.suunto-mcp/averages.json). Sleep and recovery sections need those API subscriptions; without them they say 'no data'. Write operation (updates the sidecar, appends to the history).

date.description: Day to summarize, YYYY-MM-DD. Use yesterday or earlier.

seedCtl.description: Only for the very first digest (no sidecar yet): the Fitness (CTL) shown on the watch instead of 0. Ask the user.

name: generate_daily_digest
title: Generate daily health digest
